summary: Tested the red accent line size fix (frontend only, read-only). New test /app/tests/iter25_accent_line_sizes.py: 182/182 PASS. It scans the rendered page for every small horizontal red rectangle: real leaf spans plus ::before/::after, with red background or red top border, width >= 3x height, height <= 14px. Header and form controls are excluded. Pages: Home, About, Rakhigarhi, Theatre, Craft, Workshops, Connect, Field Notes, one field-note page and the NoteReader portal popup (?note=slug). Default scan at 1920/1280/768/390: every red accent found is 42x2. Theatre: block-0-accent-line (split hero, previously 64.8x2.14 from the viewport rule in boxed-layout.css:143) and theatre-label-accent are both 42x2, as are the production h2::after and ambition aside::after. Rakhigarhi: rak-hero-accent, restoration eyebrow and ambition eyebrow are 42x2. About: 2 h2::after at 42x2. Craft: block-1 h2::after at 42x2. Workshops: 3 accents at 42x2. NoteReader fn-rule is 42x2 (was 34). The same scan with read-only PRODUCTION page content fulfilled into preview at 1920 and 390 gives 42x2 everywhere. Global override was injected only by route.fulfill of /api/public/site with header_styles {accentLineWidth:80px, accentLineThickness:5px}: every accent on every page, including the NoteReader portal, became 80x5 at 1920 and 390. Vertical red line heights were identical to the defaults (About 271/166, Rakhigarhi 124, Craft border-left 174, Workshops 118). The grey footer meta separator (1219x1 grey ::before) was identical under the override. Live editor (admin login, Theatre ?edit=1, click header, Style tab): setting Red lines length 80 and thickness 5 previews 80x5 on all 4 Theatre accents. Reset styles returns them to 42x2, then Discard. Nothing was saved. No horizontal overflow and no React or page errors. The only console errors are expected anonymous 401s from the auth check. All non-GET requests except /auth/ login were aborted; none were attempted. The fingerprint of real pages and settings is unchanged. Final capture ran: 10 pages, no TEST_, checksum valid.

issues: Size now matches, but the theatre-split-rule colour is still #a3234a (boxed-layout.css:143), while the other accents are rgb(212,20,69). This was left as is on purpose, per the brief. Only mention it if the user asks for an identical colour.

critical_code_review_comments: accent-lines.css has dead selectors: no red accent renders on Home (.page-home block-0 .lede and #our-work .sec-head .h2 match nothing), and none on Connect or Field Notes. The black/grey 16-32px eyebrow ::before lines there are not red and were correctly left alone. The selectors are harmless.

Coverage limits: #craft-reference .hb-hero + .hb-text .h2 and the craft-reference.css:74 60px rule did not appear in the current preview or production DOM for Craft, which renders only the block-1 h2::after. I could not see that selector render, but it would win if that template is used. There is no public /blog route (the blog page key exists but App.js has no route), so Blog was not scanned.
Under the override, the thickness of the vertical red lines also follows the global setting (for example 5px). This matches the existing 'vertical same thickness' design; their heights do not change.
seed_data_creation: None. No clones or settings were written; the override was injected only through route.fulfill.
